long_biography.plain_text:
Gian Mario Russo belongs to a Sorrento hotel dynasty and built his career inside its operating company. He became chief executive of SEA, owner of Hilton Sorrento Palace, where company documents place him in charge of strategy and quality management. The hotel marked 45 years of company tradition in 2026 and 25 years operating with the Hilton brand.

Russo has paired hotel management with regional tourism development. He served as vice president of the Sorrento Coast promotion consortium and joined a local infrastructure company created to improve links between central Sorrento and its port. After pandemic-era staffing shortages, he developed internal training intended to build hospitality skills and retain workers, while participating in a wider investment programme for the peninsula's leading hotels.
